finding: Claws are a useful matrix for retrospective, long-term assessment of hormonal changes in alive newborn puppies, and both cortisol and dehydroepiandrosterone (sulfate) decline from birth to 60 days of age.
mod_finding: Newborns born by vaginal delivery have higher concentrations of immunoreactive cortisol and dehydroepiandrosterone (sulfate) than newborns born by elective Cesarean section at birth.
